roots.title: State the server measures is not pushed to the dashboard
roots.fix: Publish health_update whenever a measurement is taken; refetch /api/state on SSE reconnect.

roots.title: Untrusted values reach argv where they can act as options
roots.fix: End options with -- (or reject a leading -) before every value-bearing positional, quote remote command text once, and make dry-run the default the guard assumes.
roots.proof: fix/argv-boundaries closes #81, refs #56 #59; PR #98 (#82) needs the smith: error prefix

roots.title: The engine's crash recorder writes defects for invalid input, outside the gated targets
roots.fix: Classify unreadable input as a refusal, and record a crash only through resolve_target/validate_name into an existing product dir.

roots.title: adopt crashes on an undefined WORKSPACE
roots.fix: Resolve WORKSPACE through impl_layout; isolated adopt regression.

roots.title: Setup and upgrade overwrite what the user owns
roots.fix: Replace only symlinks the setup created; upgrade compares to the recorded hash and writes atomically.

roots.title: A CLI converts its module URL by hand
roots.fix: Symptom not reproduced on macOS (jiti decodes the path); decide whether a source-level guard is worth it, and test on Windows.

roots.title: Agent instructions name flags the CLI does not have
roots.fix: Derive the ingestion agent's commands from the CLI contract and guard them with a test.
roots.proof: fix/agent-cli-drift refs #70 (roster count and redactor contract open)

roots.title: Generated JSON is indexed before it is validated
roots.fix: Validate draft envelopes at the paper_cli boundary before paper_write reads them.

roots.title: Acceptance evidence is weaker than what it is read as
roots.fix: Decide the evidence contracts: executed invariants, byte-level revision identity, blocking undecidable findings.

roots.title: Agents hold the authority the human gates depend on
roots.fix: Threat-model decision: credential isolation, permission defaults, approvals bound to authority the agent lacks.

roots.title: CI does not lint, type-check or measure coverage
roots.fix: Choose the gates and add them in slices.

roots.title: Project mutations are coordinated only in-process; two YAML parsers
roots.fix: One cross-process lock and one papersmith.yaml parser.

roots.title: Monolithic engine, tests, skills and README
roots.fix: Split by command module; progressive disclosure for skills and docs; behavioral evals.

roots.title: Multi-account Kaggle scheduling vs service policy
roots.fix: Record a policy review; the one-account-per-person attestation exists (core/team.py:39).

roots.title: OCR device selection on Intel Macs
roots.fix: Decide whether to pin CPU when MPS is unusable; surfacing OCR timeouts is part of ingestion-silent-loss.
